title: Compose N Providers Cleanly
prompt:
Apps end up nested four or five providers deep. Wrap that mess in a single `` that composes them with `reduce`. **Requirements:** 1. In `Providers.tsx`, import `ComponentType`, `ReactNode` from `react`. 2. Define and export `function compose(providers: ComponentType<{ children: ReactNode }>[]) { return ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => providers.reduceRight((acc, P) =>

hints: `reduceRight` is what you want -- the LAST provider in the array ends up innermost.
Each provider takes `{ children }`; `compose` doesn't care about props beyond that.
Add new providers by appending to the array -- no more JSX nesting tower.
